versions.label: Startup robustness + hook checks
changes: Added built-in startup self-check to detect missing critical UI/runtime hooks before interaction.
Added safe event wrappers so runtime handler errors are captured and surfaced via debug tools instead of failing silently.
Added robustness_check.sh to run repeatable local syntax and hook integrity checks before shipping changes.

versions.label: Clickable version navigation + iPad diagnostics
changes: Added clickable version navigation inside the Version History dialog to move back and forth between releases.
Highlighted the current active app version in the version list.
Added iPad-friendly debug tools and rolled the active label back to v0.1.3 while debugging.

versions.label: Live update panel visibility fixes
changes: Fixed rendering order so the Last Q-update panel is not overwritten by other explainer sections.
Highlighted the live-update panel with stronger emphasis.
Added a move-by-move one-line trace list for faster learning.

versions.label: Pinned live update panel
changes: Pinned the Last Q-update panel at the top-right explanation column.
Added sticky styling to keep live update details prominent next to the grid.

versions.label: Hyperparameter controls
changes: Exposed alpha, gamma, epsilon start, epsilon decay, and epsilon minimum in the UI.
Added validation guardrails and reset-to-defaults support for hyperparameters.
Persisted hyperparameters in localStorage and surfaced active values in the stats line.

versions.label: In-app version history
changes: Moved the live update section to the top of the right-side panel.
Added a footer app version control that opens version history.
Added in-app loading of history content via a dialog.

versions.label: Metrics + persistence
changes: Added rolling metrics for success rate, trap hits, timeouts, and average steps.
Added localStorage persistence for Q-table and training progress.
Added aria-live status and metrics updates.

versions.label: Step mode + richer live learning
changes: Added step-by-step training mode.
Added richer live learning visual feedback.
Added the right-side math explainer and live last-update details.

versions.label: Control and visualization improvements
changes: Improved interactive controls and training visualization behaviors.

versions.label: Initial browser gridworld release
changes: Initial browser-based Q-learning gridworld demo.
